snippets.requires: Targets the first scene and its existing source entry; adjust the target scene or node when needed.

snippets.title: Verified field-table CSV export
snippets.description: Export sampled field values as a CSV table and compare the table on readback. This recipe explicitly accepts losses of topology, coordinates and composite structure.
snippets.requires: Targets the first scene and its existing source entry; adjust the target scene or node when needed.

snippets.title: Verified triangulated STL export
snippets.description: Export a triangulated surface as STL and compare geometry on readback. This recipe accepts losses of fields, point identity, interior cells and composite structure.
snippets.requires: Targets the first scene and its existing source entry; adjust the target scene or node when needed.

snippets.title: Publish visible scene as glTF
snippets.description: Enable scene glTF publication alongside its existing geometry and images.
snippets.requires: Targets the first scene and its existing source entry; adjust the target scene or node when needed.

snippets.title: Vehicle wake slice study
snippets.description: Convert a velocity magnitude to downstream planes at selected X coordinates; positions use the case coordinate system.
snippets.requires: Rename the demonstration velocity expression for the case. X must be the downstream direction.

snippets.title: Pressure-coefficient exterior surface
snippets.description: Extract the external surface and calculate Cp for aerodynamic comparison.
snippets.requires: Select the body surface and replace RTData/reference values with dimensional pressure, density and freestream speed.

snippets.title: Wall y-plus exceedance check
snippets.description: Extract a wall surface and highlight values above a selected y-plus threshold.

array.label: Wall y-plus array
array.description: Actual wall y-plus scalar array, usually yPlus. Select its POINTS or CELLS association below; RTData is only a test fixture.

limit.label: Maximum acceptable y-plus
limit.description: Case-specific dimensionless acceptance limit for the chosen near-wall treatment. Select it from your modelling requirements; 30 is only a test value.

association.label: Y-plus association
association.description: OpenFOAM wall yPlus is commonly cell data. Use POINTS only if you have explicitly converted or supplied a point field.

snippets.requires: Input must contain only the intended wall boundary and the selected y-plus field. Select a limit appropriate to your near-wall model.

snippets.title: Q-criterion vortex surfaces
snippets.description: Compute velocity derivatives and extract a Q-criterion isosurface for vortex inspection.

velocity.label: Point velocity array
velocity.description: Name of an existing three-component POINTS velocity array. Convert cell velocity with cellToPoint first; spelling is case-sensitive.

snippets.requires: Use a point velocity field; the appropriate Q threshold depends on the case units and flow scale.

snippets.title: Schedule explicit physical times
snippets.description: Process an explicit list of times known to exist in the input source.
snippets.requires: Choose times supported by the selected source; availability is checked when it runs.
